finalText:
**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).** Root cause is `dep-4471`, which flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to true without raising pool size 20.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to at least `03:59:27Z`, still ongoing at log end. That is 1h45m and 530 failed requests.

One number I had not pinned before: post-onset, 100% of non-`/health` requests failed. `/health` stayed 200 the whole time because it takes no pool connection. That is why the page came 67 minutes late.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`, or just set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to false.
